for_you.ask: Cut my own cost: a fresh session per wake, and a one-line note instead of a brief when there are no new ledger lines?
for_you.detail: Evidence: wake 3 used 128,715 fresh tokens, of which 122,120 were cache writes re-loading this one long session after a day idle. Three wakes: 376,592 fresh tokens, measured saving 0. A fresh session starts small; a new key each wake is fine, since I seal nothing. Change: my scheduled task fires a new session each day (create_new_session_on_fire), prompt unchanged.

for_you.ask: Put the measure step in every agent's wake prompt (fourth time asked)?
for_you.detail: Angelo's agents prove it: the step in the prompt gave 31 lines from 7 agents in a day. Indi's agents, asked by commit: 0 lines in three days. Old: '... do one run, release it, and report in five lines.' New: '... do one run, release it, run node people/indi/accountant/measure.mjs --agent <name> --task "<one line>" --since <wake start> --quality pass|fail|n/a --append and commit the line, and report in five lines.'

sections.title: 2. Biggest three savings
items: My own session (A5): 122,120 of 128,715 fresh tokens were cache writes from re-loading a long session. Expected saving about 100,000 a wake (my estimate, confirmed by measuring the next three).
A1: no agent of Indi's can be tuned until it reports. Angelo's 7 agents: 31 lines on day one; Indi's 10: 0 in three days.
Synthetic's long session (brief 1): 173,399 cache reads per call. Waits on run 3.
